We address these through Hyperbolic Residual Quantization, which leverages the exponential volume growth of the Poincaré ball to naturally stratify encoding capacity, and a Soft Length Controller, which enables differentiable length prediction via continuous layer retention probabilities regularized by PIBA-derived priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VarLenRec achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods in recommendation accuracy and training/inference efficiency, revealing the importance of adaptive encoding capacity in generative recommendation.

</details>


### [610] [Revisiting the Adam-SGD Gap in LLM Pre-Training: The Role of Large Effective Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17787)
*Athanasios Glentis,Dawei Li,Chung-Yiu Yau,Mingyi Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了LLM预训练中SGD与Adam的性能差距这一长期共识，指出其主因并非SGD本身不适配预训练，而是SGD无法维持与Adam相当的"大有效学习率"。作者通过经验与理论分析发现预训练中梯度范数极小、权重/梯度比极大（随batch size增大而加剧），使得大学习率成为必需；而SGD的"无约束更新"在大学习率下又因层级梯度尖峰与输出层按token类的梯度失衡而发散。通过引入层级RMS范数裁剪与输出层按token类裁剪两种简单机制，作者首次使SGD能在预训练中稳定使用100–300这样的大学习率，将1B参数LLaMA在1M token batch下与Adam的验证损失差距从57%缩小到约3.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学界普遍认为SGD在LLM预训练中远逊于Adam，但差距根源一直不清。已有工作分别从数据重尾/类别不均衡（Kunstner et al. 2024）、损失几何病态（Pan & Li 2023）、Hessian块异质性（Zhang et al. 2024）等角度解释，但这些都是"孤立症状"，整体训练动态与SGD失败的关联仍缺乏系统刻画。本文动机在于：作者观察到SGD即便充分调参也只在初始化点附近极小邻域内探索（解空间比Adam小50倍），其"有效学习率"远小于Adam，因而提出核心问题——为何SGD不能直接用更大学习率？由此把差距归因于"大有效学习率的缺失"这一高层动态因素，而非试图提出新优化器。

Method: 方法包含三部分。(1)有效学习率与训练动态刻画：定义动量算法中每个参数的有效学习率 a_i^(t)（SGD为η_t，Adam为η_t/(√v_i+ε)），逐层追踪训练损失、权重更新范数、权重/随机梯度范数比。(2)理论分析：定理3.2将minibatch梯度按token类别分解（头尾集合划分），对头token用偏差-方差分解（式8）、对尾token用"softmax背景-标签命中"分解（式9），给出‖G‖_F²的普适上界（式7），并证明在LLM式头token充分训练、尾token欠训练且batch size大的条件下E‖G‖_F²=O(1/B)，从而权重/梯度比Ω(√B)（推论E.9、E.10）；对输出层给出κ=1的特化，对中间层给出κ=V的特化（定理F.2）。定理4.1（E.11）证明训练早期每token类梯度范数下界∝q_j s_j²/B，故类间梯度比Ω(q_i/q_j)，且随batch size增大而加剧。(3)提出SGD-LL：对非输出层权重与动量施加层级RMS范数裁剪（阈值τ，保证更新RMS≤τ），对输出层先做按token类的L2范数裁剪（阈值δ）再整体施加层级裁剪；裁剪仅针对尖峰，主体梯度不变，从而支持LR=100–300。实验设置：LLaMA 130M/350M/1B在C4上（130M/350M用0.5M token batch，1B用1M token batch，Chinchilla最优token量），T5分词器词表32K，序列长256，cosine调度+10% warmup，BF16 AMP，weight decay=0，SGD β=0.9，Adam β₁=0.9/β₂=0.95；另做GPT-2/FineWeb复现、多种子实验、Adam的β₂与weight decay消融、以及仅用单一裁剪的消融。

Result: 有效学习率：Adam比SGD大2–4个数量级（Adam约10²–10⁴，SGD峰值仅0.5），Adam更新范数约为SGD的100倍，SGD最终权重离初始化的距离比Adam小约50倍。权重/SG范数比在初始化时10¹–10⁴、训练中10³–10⁵，远高于ImageNet CNN训练的10⁰–10³，且随batch size从64→2048→65536持续增大（均值5.9e4→2.3e5→5.8e5），与理论O(1/B)梯度界一致。梯度不规则性：训练早期频繁出现层级梯度范数尖峰；输出层按token类梯度高度失衡，高频token梯度显著更大，Adam通过逐坐标归一化自动均衡（SGD无此机制）。SGD-LL（LR=100/200/300）：130M验证损失3.24 vs Adam 3.11 vs SGD 5.07；350M：2.87 vs 2.78 vs 4.14；1B：2.60 vs 2.51 vs 3.95，相对差距从57%降到约3.5%；权重离初始化距离从SGD的6.2e3升至1.3e5，接近Adam的7.2e5。GPT-2 124M/FineWeb上SGD-LL差距7.78%（SGD为49.7%）。多种子实验显示SGD-LL方差极小。消融表明两种裁剪缺一不可，单独使用任一种时LR>1即出现loss spike发散；Adam的β₂与weight decay调参影响极小（≤0.5%）。

Conclusion: 结论是：SGD在LLM预训练中的大部分劣势源于其无法维持Adam级别的大有效学习率，而这又是预训练中小梯度范数、大权重/梯度比（随batch size加剧）所必然要求的；阻碍SGD使用大学习率的两类具体原因是层级梯度尖峰与输出层按token类的梯度失衡，用针对性裁剪即可"治疗"，使SGD在预训练中首次稳定运行于100–300的大学习率，从而消除大部分差距。作者强调本工作目的是理解预训练现象而非提出新算法，残余差距仍需更细粒度因素解释；同时该视角也解释了为何小batch下SGD与Adam差距收窄（因为大batch才使权重/梯度比变大、放大大学习率需求），与Srećković et al. (2025)、Marek et al. (2025)的观察相互印证。

Abstract: It is widely believed that stochastic gradient descent (SGD) performs significantly worse than adaptive optimizers such as Adam in pre-training Large Language Models (LLMs). Yet the underlying reason for this gap remains unclear. In this work, we attribute a large part of the discrepancy to SGD's inability to sustain learning rates comparable to Adam's much larger effective learning rates. Through empirical and theoretical analysis of LLM pre-training dynamics, we identify that training is characterized by small gradient norms and large weight-to-gradient ratios, an effect that becomes more pronounced with larger batch sizes typical in pre-training, necessitating such large effective learning rates. However, we find that output-layer gradient magnitudes become highly uneven across token classes, and that large gradient spikes frequently occur during training. Together, these effects severely restrict the admissible learning rate of SGD. Guided by this understanding, we show that simple clipping mechanisms that stabilize SGD at large learning rates enable it to recover most of Adam's performance. In our large-scale experiments, the validation loss gap between large-learning-rate SGD and Adam shrinks from more than 50% to only about 3.5% when pre-training a 1B-parameter LLaMA model with a 1M-token batch size.

</details>


### [611] [HydroAgent: Closing the Gap Between Frontier LLMs and Human Experts in Hydrologic Model Calibration via Simulator-Grounded RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17792)
*Zhi Li,Songkun Yan,Jie Cao,Mofan Zhang,Anjiang Wei,Jinwoong Yoo,Yang Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对九个前沿LLM智能体在业务化分布式水文模型（CREST/EF5）参数率定任务上的能力做了系统性基准测试，发现其表现普遍不及人类专家（面板平均最优NSE约-0.16至0.75，且仅Opus-4.7在一个站达到专家水平），并论证该差距源于"领域接地"而非参数规模。为此提出HydroAgent：在开源Qwen3-4B上先做监督微调（2,576条专家轨迹片段）再做以NSE为可验证奖励的GRPO（RLSF，带模拟器在环），使面板平均NSE由-0.14提升至+0.20、中位数由+0.09提升至+0.50，且四个站点的NSE、相关性、峰现时间偏差全部改善；核心主张是"小规模领域策略+模拟器在环强化学习"对地球系统科学比持续放大通用前沿模型更具算力效率与物理忠实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式水文模型（本文用美国国家气象局用于山洪预报的CREST/EF5）的参数率定是水资源管理的核心瓶颈：供水、水库调度、干旱监测、基础设施设计、山洪预警都依赖它；但每个流域都需要资深水文专家耗费数小时至数天把水文过程线特征翻译成高维参数向量的调整，且经验难以跨流域迁移。随着气候变化加剧水文极端事件、率定需求上升，而受训水文专家供给不足，因此需要AI承接这一工作。前沿智能体（CoT+工具调用）理论上已具备读取CSV、编辑控制文件、调用Linux二进制的能力，但是否真能完成率定、以及失败模式揭示差距根源在哪里，仍是空白。此外，NSE等单一标量奖励存在峰值主导、单事件敏感等病态，真实专家是看整条过程线的，这为后续引入视觉语言验证器留出空间。

Method: 两条互补的技术路线。（1）基准测试：在harbor框架的terminal-2 harness中，给九个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.6/4.7、Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5/5.4/5.4-pro、Gemini 2.5-pro/3.1-pro/3-flash）与入门水文专家同任务：流域描述、站点序列、MRMS降水/PET栅格、CREST控制文件模板与NSE目标（0.8075），每站20轮×每轮最多10个候选参数扫描（上限200次EF5模拟），2小时超时；暴露四个工具set_parameters（13个标量乘子，附物理边界）、run_simulation（返回过程线及峰值误差、时滞、水量平衡比、退水段斜率、峰现时间、基流、事件数等多指标诊断）、evaluate（NSE + KGE分量/RMSE/PBIAS/高低流量KGE）、parse_failure（根因解释）；训练集10站（539–2401 km²），留出4站（329–40,792 km²）测试。（2）HydroAgent：基座Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507；阶段一SFT——用GPT-5教师在29个美国站73次率定运行中蒸馏并切分为2,576条⟨prompt, tool-call, tool-result⟩片段，按最终NSE百分位质量加权，剔除最终NSE≤0.6的运行；阶段二RLSF——基于verl 0.5 + SGLang多轮工具调度实现GRPO，每prompt采样K=8条最多50轮的rollout，奖励为逐轮整形（合法set_parameters +0.02、合法run_simulation +0.05、evaluate给ΔNSE、parse_failure −0.5）加终局奖励（clip(NSE*, −1, 1) + 0.5·1{NSE*>τ} + 0.02·n_eval + 0.10·max(0, n_improve−1) − 1.0·1{empty}）；全参BF16 FSDP（不用LoRA），4×H100 80GB，actor lr 1e-6、KL系数0.2（锚定SFT初始化，低于此会token级退化）、熵系数0.01、temperature 1.0/top-p 0.95、batch 4×8、30 epoch，EF5调用用32路信号量限流；评测时前沿模型与HydroAgent共用同一harness与预算，仅权重不同。

Result: 前沿模型：面板平均最优NSE从−0.16（GPT-5.4）到0.75（Sonnet 4.6），最强模型聚集在0.65–0.75区间，跨三个厂商与能力层级可复现；除Opus-4.7在06279500一个站外无模型达到人类专家参考（0.85，专家参考由熟手水文专家配合DREAM近似贝叶斯采样器产生）；GPT-5与GPT-5.4全预算内未取得正NSE。三类反复出现的失败模式：(1)过早终止——pro级推理模型在剩余预算下1–2轮即退出；(2)越界参数——弱模型反复提出负im、wm>10等非法值浪费EF5调用；(3)诊断-动作错配——能识别退水段过陡却去调河道演算参数而非控制退水的土壤蓄水/渗漏参数；best-NSE与已用轮数强耦合（good档模型平均用17.7轮，其余仅5.5轮）。HydroAgent：四个留出站NSE全部提升（02338660 +5%，01403060从深负转正提升超200%），放电相关性0至+41%，|Lag|各站收缩+23%至+200%，峰值流量比误差3/4改善（+1%至+87%，02338660为−163%的反向退化）；面板平均NSE −0.14→+0.20、中位数+0.09→+0.50，一个流域由负转正。消融（附录C）显示两阶段互补而非可替代：SFT单独在3/4站退化（面板均值−0.14→−4.79，02338660从+0.65崩至−17.53），因为最大似然只学到教师轨迹的"收敛分布"而非"迭代过程"，每回合仅发起1–4次EF5模拟、每集4次解析失败；加入GRPO后模拟次数恢复到12–17、50轮预算用满、解析失败归零，三站相对SFT提升（+18.14/+1.43/+0.58），仅01403060回落。边际贡献：在SFT之上加RLSF为+4.99，单独SFT相对基座为−4.65。

Conclusion: 核心论点是：前沿LLM智能体在率定任务上系统性低于人类专家，其天花板稳定在面板平均NSE约0.65–0.75，且该差距不是参数规模问题而是"领域接地"（calibration grounding）与"长程投入"问题；瓶颈在于模型既要知道"该动哪个参数"，也要愿意持续迭代。对地球系统科学而言，当物理模拟器评估廉价（一次流域模拟数秒至数分钟）且非可微时，用模拟器作为验证器、以SFT提供工具调用语法、以GRPO/RLSF提供长程信用分配，是比放大通用前沿模型更算力高效、更物理忠实的路径；地球数据的多模态性（遥感栅格、站点序列、预报员文本叙事）使领域智能体成为AI in physical science 的高杠杆方向。局限与后续：评测仅限CONUS 10训练站（≤2401 km²）+4留出站（329–40,792 km²），面板均值样本过小，需扩展至Caravan约6830站的全球数据集检验跨水文气候区泛化；配方目前只在CREST与单一小基座验证，是否迁移到SAC-SMA/VIC/mHM及其他开源骨干仍未知；应以读取渲染后水文过程线的视觉语言验证器替代单一NSE标量以做形状感知的信用分配并修补02338660的峰值比退化；风险上须保留人类专家在环，防止误设参数集传播为虚假/漏报山洪预警与应急资源错配。全文公开9×20条轨迹及完整训练配置以便复现。

Abstract: Calibrating distributed hydrologic models is a critical bottleneck across operational water resources management - streamflow prediction, reservoir operation, drought monitoring, infrastructure design, and flood forecasting all depend on it. Each basin demands an expert to translate hydrograph signatures into adjustments of a high-dimensional parameter vector, and the resulting workflow does not transfer between watersheds. We ask: can frontier large language model (LLM) agents replace the human hydrologic modeler, and if not, what would it take? We benchmark nine frontier LLM agents - Claude Opus 4.6/4.7, Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5/5.4/5.4-pro, and Gemini 2.5-pro/3.1-pro/3-flash - on the operational CREST distributed hydrologic model used by the U.S. National Weather Service for flash-flood forecasting. Best-of-twenty-rounds Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) across four held-out gauges spanning 329-40,792 km2 ranges from -0.16 (GPT-5.4) to 0.75 (Sonnet 4.6); the ceiling reproduces across all three vendors and capability tiers, with the strongest models concentrating in the 0.65-0.75 band, and no model reaches the human-expert reference except Opus-4.7 on one gauge. We argue this gap is not a parameter-count problem but a domain-grounding problem. We then propose HYDROAGENT, fine-tuning open-weight Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning on 2,576 expert calibration trajectories and Group-Relative Policy Optimization using NSE as a verifiable reward from online CREST simulations - reinforcement learning with simulation feedback (RLSF). For Earth system science, a small domain-tuned policy with simulator-in-the-loop RL is a more compute-efficient and physically faithful path than scaling generic frontier models, and the multi-modal richness of Earth data - remote sensing, in-situ time series, and forecaster narrative - makes domain agents a leveraged direction for AI in physical science.

</details>


### [612] [When Accuracy Is Not Enough: Uncertainty Collapse between Noisy Label Learning and Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17795)
*Ningkang Peng,Jingyang Mao,Runhan Zhou,Peirong Ma,Yanhui Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"学习者无关"的 ACC–OOD 统一基准：冻结噪声标签学习（LNL）模型，在标准化近/远 OOD 路由与后验分数下同时报告闭集精度与开放世界可靠性。基准揭示了一种被命名为"不确定性坍缩"（uncertainty collapse）的病理：低置信度且分类错误的 ID 样本在分数与特征空间上与 OOD 样本重叠，导致高 ACC 的 LNL 模型在 ID-错误/OOD 交界处丧失可分性。作者以虚拟边缘正则化（VMR）作为插件式修复探针（在可信 ID 批次上合成边界虚拟离群样本、拉宽 energy margin），在不替换宿主目标、不损害闭集精度的前提下部分恢复远 OOD 可靠性，并呼吁 LNL 基准同时报告闭集泛化、开放世界可靠性与结构性重叠诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 噪声标签学习（LNL）长期只用干净测试集上的闭集分类精度做基准，但部署时模型还必须能拒识训练标签空间之外的输入（拒绝/弃权/分诊）。近期的零散观察表明标签噪声会损害后验 OOD 检测、破坏"ID 精度与 OOD 泛化对齐"这一惯例，但这仍是一个未解决的**基准层面**问题：现代 LNL 训练中的样本选择、重标注、协同训练、对比过滤、半监督精修等机制会重塑置信度与特征几何，使得"精度提升"与"OOD 可靠性提升"脱钩。作者因此希望：（1）建立统一、可复现且学习者无关的 ACC–OOD 评测协议；（2）从表征几何层面解释这种脱钩的机制；（3）检验该失败是否可被轻量干预部分修复。

Method: 1）**统一 ACC–OOD 基准**：冻结各 LNL 检查点，后验计算分数（Energy 为主分数，MSP/MaxLogit/margin/entropy 与 ODIN、Mahalanobis、ReAct、DNN、ViM 作为对照探针），统一转向为"OOD 更大"后计算 AUROC 与 FPR95；数据覆盖 CIFAR-10/100 合成噪声（对称 0.2/0.5/0.8/0.9、非对称 0.4）、人工噪声 CIFAR-N、真实噪声 Food-101N 与 Animal-10N；近 OOD 用跨 CIFAR 邻居，远 OOD 固定为 SVHN、LSUN-resize、Places365、DTD、MNIST；7 个学习者（DivideMix、LongReMix、L2B、PSSCL、UNICON、RRL、ProMix）。全过程不使用任何 OOD 数据做训练、拟合检测器、调阈值或选检查点。2）**机制诊断**：定义 S_wrong（用干净标签判定的错分类 ID 集合），按 MSP 中位数把 ID-correct/ID-wrong 各分高/低置信度，构成五组分类法；计算各组 vs 池化远 OOD 的 AUROC 与质量占比；用核平滑 Energy 密度、ECE/AUROC 相关（ρ≈−0.8）、penultimate 特征的参与比/MLE 内在维/角度漂移（cos≈0.84）、clean-vs-noise 对照等定位坍缩来源。3）**VMR 修复探针**：沿用 VOS 思想，仅用宿主算法产出的可信标注 mini-batch，在特征空间低似然/类间边界合成虚拟离群样本并施加轻量分离项，目标 L = L_host + λ_vos·L_VOS；测试时打分协议不变（仍为后验 Energy）。用配对基线/修复检查点的坍缩诊断（R_collapse、C_score、M_collapse）验证结构是否改变。

Result: 1）**ACC–OOD 解耦/反转成立**：CIFAR-100 sym-0.5 上高 ACC 方法的近 OOD AUROC 从 47.8（RRL）到 77.4（PSSCL），远 OOD AUROC 从 56.6（RRL）到 76.1（UNICON）；最佳 ACC 方法常非最佳 OOD 方法，RRL 整体最差（远 OOD AUROC 30.8–66.3）。真实噪声上结果混合：Food-101N 呈对齐（RRL ACC 85.0/AUROC 97.7/FPR95 10.4 全面最优），Animal-10N 与 CIFAR-N 仍出现精度与远 OOD 分离（如 C100N：L2B ACC 58.9/AUROC 79.2，ProMix 71.7/69.8）。2）**坍缩机制**：低置信度 ID-wrong 样本占 ID-wrong 质量的 93.2%，在多数设定中占主导；其 ID-wrong vs OOD AUROC 仅 0.3–0.5（如 C100 sym-0.5：ID-wrong 低置信组 AU 0.5、占 43.0% 质量），而 ID-correct 低置信组仍为 0.6–0.8。clean→noisy 训练可使 DivideMix 的 ID-wrong/OOD AUROC 从约 71% 跌至约 50%，即使 ID 错误数反而下降，说明问题在于错误"落点位置"而非数量。表征上 ID-wrong 更低维（参与比 23–30 vs ID-correct 50–69，OOD 35–42）且与 OOD 角度漂移一致（cos≈0.84），在特征空间中充当 ID-correct 与 far-OOD 的"桥"。3）**VMR 效果**：PSSCL+VMR 在 ACC 上基本持平或略升（C10 s0.2 96.4→97.2，s0.5 95.6→96.3，s0.8 93.7→95.9，asym0.4 93.9→94.4），远 OOD AUROC 一致提升（+2.4、+3.6、+3.2、+6.2；C10N 各 split +9.7~+13.6），远 OOD FPR95 同步下降（如 s0.2 24.0→18.3）。结论：坍缩是部分可修复的失败模式，但修复远 OOD 明显快于近 OOD，仍属"部分恢复"。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"LNL 精度高但 OOD 不可靠"从零散观察上升为一个可度量的结构性病理：uncertainty collapse——低置信度错分类 ID 样本在分数与特征空间侵入 OOD 支持域，使后验检测无法区分"未解决的 ID 错误"与"真正的新颖性"，而非简单的校准误差或全局弱检测器；该现象由噪声训练压力驱动（干净标签下大幅缓解），在 CIFAR-10/100 合成噪声与人工/真实噪声（Food-101N、Animal-10N、CIFAR-N）上均有体现，且与 Energy 分数族无关。作者据此主张 LNL 基准应联合报告闭集泛化、开放世界可靠性（近/远 OOD AUROC、FPR95）与结构性重叠诊断（ID-wrong/OOD AUROC、五组分类法），并提出未来 LNL 目标应以其对 ID-错误/OOD 界面的改善而非 ACC 单项来评判。VMR 证明了边界级能量分离可在不替换宿主目标、不使用干净标签的前提下部分修复该接口，验证了"诊断→干预"闭环。局限包括：机制证据集中于 CIFAR 族 + PreAct-ResNet-18 的受控设置，多数基准为单次运行、仅供趋势而非方差估计，且若干扩展（骨干网络、修复强度、合成策略、标注子集、多分数族、检测器对照、形式化定义与消融）在本 arXiv 预印本中被省略；作者明确指出尚未穷尽距离型/梯度型 OOD 范式的完整审计，并提示在医疗影像、自动驾驶等长尾未标注场景中研究该问题对部署可靠性具有更广意义。

Abstract: Learning with noisy labels (LNL) is typically benchmarked by closed-set classification accuracy, yet deployment often requires classifiers to reject out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We present a learner-agnostic ACC-OOD benchmark that freezes LNL checkpoints and evaluates them with standardized near-/far-OOD routing and post-hoc scores across synthetic and real label noise. The benchmark reveals a recurring failure mode: high closed-set accuracy does not ensure OOD reliability, because low-confidence, misclassified in-distribution samples can overlap the score and feature regions occupied by OOD inputs under noisy training. We term this pathology uncertainty collapse. This structural overlap can make high-accuracy LNL methods lose separability at the ID-error/OOD interface under standard OOD scores. As an intervention, we study Virtual Margin Regularization (VMR), a lightweight repair probe demonstrated mainly with PSSCL that synthesizes boundary virtual outliers on trusted ID batches and widens the energy margin. VMR partially reduces the collapse-induced far-OOD failure without replacing the host objective or sacrificing closed-set accuracy in the tested settings. These results support LNL benchmarks that co-report closed-set generalization, open-world reliability, and structural overlap diagnostics.

</details>


### [613] [GenTS: A Comprehensive Benchmark Library for Generative Time Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17804)
*Chenxi Wang,Xiaorong Wang,Peiyang Li,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GenTS 是一个面向生成式时间序列模型（GAN/VAE/Diffusion/Flow/微分方程）的开源基准库，基于 PyTorch + PyTorch Lightning 构建，统一了数据预处理、模型训练与全景式评估三大环节，内置 15+ 多领域数据集、25+ SOTA 模型与模型无关/模型相关两类指标。作者在合成、预测、插补三大任务上开展大规模基准测试，结论是扩散模型整体最优（CSDI、DiffusionTS、ImagenTime 跨任务最通用，COSCIGAN/ImagenTime 适合合成，TMDM 适合非平稳序列预测），微分方程类模型偏弱但被低估，并提出生成式时序基础模型、鲁棒评估、在线自适应三个未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列库（TSLib、GluonTS 等）主要为判别式模型设计，围绕 MSE/交叉熵等回归或分类目标提供标准化流程，其 API 与工作流难以容纳对抗训练、扩散去噪等学习数据分布而非输入输出映射的生成式范式；而 TSGM、Synthcity、ProbTS、TSGBench、CTBench 等生成式相关库又往往只覆盖单一任务（无条件合成或仅预测）、缺乏多领域数据集与完整数据处理/训练管线，导致无法对生成式时序模型做系统、可复现的横向评估与模型选型。

Method: 1) 形式化定义时序生成：X∈R^{T×D}，覆盖无条件生成 q_θ(X)≈p(X)、条件生成 q_θ(X|y)≈p(X|y)，并将任务细分为合成（含类别标签引导）、预测 p(X_pred|X_obs)、插补 p(X|X̃,m)，给出插补重组公式 X̂=X⊙m+X′⊙(1−m)。2) 库设计：BaseDataModule（继承 LightningDataModule）统一切分、dataloader、掩码模拟缺失、look-back 窗口分配与不规则时间步丢弃，内置交通/能源/金融/医疗/天气/物理等 15+ 数据集及两个模拟数据集 Spiral2D（螺旋，含顺/逆时针两类标签）、SineND；BaseModel（继承 LightningModule）实现 training_step/validation_step/sample 三要素，缺验证的 GAN（如 TimeGAN）补充 Wasserstein 距离作验证指标；模型多为官方代码的 torch 迁移，另实现 VanillaVAE/VanillaGAN/VanillaDDPM(DiT-1D)/VanillaMAF 四个朴素基线。3) 评估体系：模型无关指标（Wasserstein 距离、CRPS、MSE 等）与模型相关指标（PS、DS、C-FID，基于 TS2Vec/GRU 辅助网络），并提供 t-SNE、预测区间可视化。4) 实验设置：合成任务 T=24、D=min(16,D_N)，单/多变量两种设定，指标为 WD、C-FID、PS、DS；预测任务 L_obs=L_pred=96，采样 50 次得概率预测，均值作确定性预测，用 MSE 与 CRPS 评估；插补任务 L=24、缺失率 0.2，同样 50 次采样，MSE/CRPS；统一最多 300 epoch、patience=10 早停，硬件为 1×RTX 4090 24GB + 4×RTX 3080 Ti。

Result: 合成任务：扩散族整体最佳，尤其在 PS/DS 上；ImagenTime 在 PS/DS 领先，COSCIGAN 在 C-FID 与 WD 领先（多变量下其中心判别器设计优势更明显，Top-3 计数 11/13），TimeVAE 均衡但中等；单变量下 FourierFlow 表现均衡，FIDE 仅在 Stocks/ETTh 有优势。类别标签引导合成：TimeVQVAE 的簇对齐与统计接近度最好，GAN 虽能生成可区分类别但与真实簇对齐差；Physionet 上所有模型 DS≈0.5，说明后验分类器可轻易区分真伪。预测任务：CSDI 与 TMDM 在确定性与概率精度上常年居前，TMDM 借助非平稳处理骨干在 Stocks 上优势绝对；VanillaMAF/VanillaVAE 等朴素基线在 ETTh、Electricity、Spiral2D 上具竞争力；VAE/LS4 在 Weather、MuJoCo 等波动大场景波动显著（LS4 最高 82.5 MSE）。插补任务：扩散模型全面统治，CSDI 在多数数据集最优，随后是 ImagenTime、DiffusionTS，兼顾点精度与不确定性校准；微分方程类与朴素基线普遍偏弱。效率：GAN/VAE 计算开销集中在训练、推理快；扩散模型推理开销大但训练不慢，适合离线部署；微分方程模型因需频繁求解初值问题导致反向传播计算图庞大。

Conclusion: GenTS 以模块化设计覆盖数据—训练—评估全链路，填补了生成式时序模型缺乏综合基准库的空白，代码与文档已开源。选型建议：跨任务通用首选 DiffusionTS 与 ImagenTime；合成任务用 COSCIGAN（分布拟合）与 ImagenTime（下游有用性），单变量合成用 FourierFlow，标签引导合成用 TimeVQVAE；预测任务首选 CSDI，非平稳数据选 TMDM；插补任务强烈推荐 CSDI 等扩散模型。微分方程类模型虽整体落后，但其内蕴归纳偏置在连续时间序列生成上仍属有潜力但待探索的方向。未来方向为：生成式时序基础模型（全局分布拟合+可控推理）、更鲁棒全面的评估指标（PS/DS 对辅助评价器敏感）、面向动态分布漂移的低延迟在线自适应开发。后续将持续扩充数据集与新模型、覆盖更多新兴生成任务、构建跨任务与任务特定的系统性评估框架。

Abstract: Generative models have demonstrated remarkable potential in time series analysis tasks, like synthesis, forecasting, imputation, etc. However, offering limited coverage for generative models, existing time series libraries are mainly engineered for discriminative models, with standardized workflows for specific tasks, such as optimizing Mean Squared Errors for time series forecasting. This rigid structure is fundamentally incompatible with the distinct and often complex paradigms of generative models (e.g., adversarial training, diffusion processes), which learn the underlying data distribution rather than a direct input-output mapping. To this end, we proposed GenTS, a comprehensive and extensible benchmark library designed for systematic assessment on generative time series models. GenTS features a unified data preprocessing pipeline, a collection of versatile models, and panoramic evaluation metrics. Its modular design also enables the researchers to flexibly customize beyond our built-in datasets and models. Based on GenTS, we conducted benchmarking experiments under diverse tasks, accordingly offering suggestions for model selection and identifying potential directions for future research. Our codes are open-source at https://github.com/WillWang1113/GenTS. The official tutorials and document are available at https://willwang1113.github.io/GenTS/.

</details>


### [614] [AMO: Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17806)
*Xinlin Zhuang,Panyi Ouyang,Yichen Li,Jiangming Shi,Yizhang Chen,Shuman Liu,Ying Qian,Weiyang Liu,Haibo Zhang,Imran Razzak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对 Muon 优化器中"所有参数矩阵统一使用同一套 Newton-Schulz (NS) 正交化调度"的假设提出质疑。作者通过系统性实证研究证明：不同矩阵的正交化难度存在普遍且结构化的异质性，该异质性主要由矩阵几何（谱条件数）决定，并在算子类型、训练阶段、网络深度三个维度上动态演化。基于此提出 AMO（Operator-level Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization）：一种"先观察后锁定"（observe-then-commit）方法，在训练早期按算子类型在线测量权重几何信号，随后将固定的 NS 迭代预算在 7 类算子间重分配，并在训练余下阶段锁定该方案。AMO 在 Llama3.1-1.4B 与 Qwen3-1.7B 上分别超越最强基线 +0.76 / +0.51（12 项下游任务平均分），在标准预训练、延长预训练与持续预训练中均一致有效，且不增加正交化算力开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 已成为大规模预训练中 AdamW 的有力替代，其核心操作是基于 Newton-Schulz (NS) 迭代的矩阵正交化。NS 设计只有两个自由度：迭代步数 T 与系数序列 {(a_k,b_k,c_k)}。现有变体（Muon、You、PE/Polar Express、CANS、Turbo）均使用全局共享的系数表，ROOT 虽按矩阵形状特化系数，但仍把同形状矩阵（如 attn_k 与 attn_v）视为可互换。作者的关键问题是：矩阵之间是否真的存在正交化难度差异？差异来自哪个维度？

为回答该问题，作者先做了两个前期实验：(1) 数据课程实验——在 2 个模型族、2 个优化器、4 种 LR 调度、3 种数据排序共 16 组配置下，按 Educational Value 分数的单调排序（Ascend/Descend）均劣于随机打散（Uniform），说明"数据侧课程"不是可靠解法，需转向优化器侧；(2) 模型几何分析——在 70M~1.7B 共 8 个模型上跟踪 Muon 动量矩阵，得到四条发现：F1 条件数 κ(M_t) 与形状归一化 NS 残差 ε̃_NS 强相关（Pearson r=0.729，Llama3.1 0.722–0.813，Qwen3 0.671–0.912）；F2 算子类型的中位 κ 轨迹持续分离，跨族的主导困难算子不同（Qwen3 为 attn_v，Llama3.1 为 attn_q/attn_o），mlp_down 最易；F3 层间差异幅度小；F4 层间相对次序在训练中会反转（如 attn_q 浅/深层在第 120 步反转），且附录 G.3 表明反转在 warmup 后仍持续（整体反转率 10.17%/8.50%），并非初始化瞬态。

因此动因可归纳为：均匀 NS 调度会导致全模型正交化质量不均；差异需要在线测量（不能靠架构先验），且应在算子类型粒度上自适应（层深度不可靠）。

Method: **核心框架（Alg.1）**：Phase 1 观察 → 规划（Planning）→ Phase 2 过渡与锁定。

1. **信号定义**：输入侧几何信号 ℓ(M)=σ_min^(τ)(M)/‖M‖_F（截断阈值 τ=1e-10，精确 SVD fp32 计算），在良态区间内与 1/κ(M) 单调相关，可直接接入 PE 多项式组合器。观察期记录 ℓ_eff^(i)=ℓ_raw^(i)/s（s=1.01 数值安全因子）。

2. **Phase 1 观察（D3）**：在统一 5 步 NS 基线调度下训练，每 Δ_obs 步对每个算子类型均匀采样 n_smp 个矩阵（不采全部以提效），记录 per-type 中位数，直至 T_obs。

3. **规划（D1+D2）**：用 median-of-medians 稳健聚合得 ℓ_robust^(i)，再向保守基线 ℓ_base=1e-3 收缩：ℓ_target^(i)=α·ℓ_robust^(i)+(1−α)·ℓ_base。对每个类型 i 与候选步数 k∈[3,7] 调用 PE-simulate(ℓ_target^(i),k) 得投影误差曲线 E_i(k)=1−ℓ_after-final。

4. **BudgetAllocate（Alg.2）**：在总预算 ΣT_i=B=round(r·|𝒪|·T_base) 与整数箱约束 [k_min,k_max] 下，通过 add/remove/transfer 三趟贪心求解。附录 C.2 给出定理：若 E_i(k) 严格递减且离散凸（边际收益随 k 非增）、预算可行，则该解是分离离散凸优化的全局最优解——通过证明最优性条件 ΔE_i(T_i)≤ΔE_j(T_j−1) 与交换论证达成。

5. **Phase 2 过渡与锁定**：为避免调度突变导致正交化更新跳变、破坏动量缓冲，用 Δ=300 步对 T_i 与 ℓ_eff^(i) 做联合线性插值；采用两级取整（先取整总和 B(u)，再在约束下分配各类型步数）保证总和单调从 7·5 到 B；每个 NS 步都在插值状态 (T_i(u), ℓ_eff^(i)(u)) 上重新生成 PE 系数。u=Δ 后冻结调度与系数、停止几何采集。

**默认超参**：小模型 (T_obs=1200, Δ_obs=150, n_smp=8)，大模型 (3000, 375, 8)；α=0.7；Δ=300；r=1.0；k∈[3,7]。

**对照方法**：AdamW；Muon-KJ、Muon-You、Muon-PE、Muon-CANS、Muon-Turbo、AdaMuon、NorMuon、Drop-Muon、PRISM、ROOT。

**实验设置**：Llama-3.1（75M/480M/760M/1.4B）与 Qwen3（70M/300M/0.6B/1.7B）稠密 decoder-only Transformer；GQA+RMSNorm+SwiGLU；FineWeb-Edu，2048 长度打包；1× Chinchilla（20 tok/param），延长预训练 2×/5×/10×（24B/60B/120B tokens）；持续预训练自 60B checkpoint 追加 36B SlimPajama；bf16 + Flash-Attention-2，梯度裁剪 1.0，seed 42，6–32× H100 80GB；评测用 lm-evaluation-harness 12 项任务（常识推理/科学知识/通用理解，除 MMLU-Pro 5-shot 外均 zero-shot），报告未加权平均。

Result: **主结果**：AMO 在所有族/尺度上最优。Llama3.1-1.4B：39.69 vs Muon-PE 38.93（+0.76）；Qwen3-1.7B：40.75 vs 40.24（+0.51）；Llama3.1-760M 37.26（+0.20）；Qwen3-0.6B 37.77（+0.44）。增益广泛分布于 12 项任务而非集中于个别基准。

**延长预训练（Qwen3-0.6B）**：2×/5×/10× 下 AMO 达 37.90/39.27/40.06，分别领先最强基线 +0.39/+0.23/+0.29；Llama3.1-1.4B 2× 下 39.97 vs 38.99。

**持续预训练**：AMO 全程领先，step 2000/6000/末尾优势 +0.12/+0.26，最终 40.31 vs 40.15 (Muon-PE) / 40.01 (Muon-KJ)。

**稳健性**：Llama3.1-1.4B 三种子配对实验，AMO 相对 Muon 平均 +0.50±0.22，相对最优静态调度 +0.58±0.13；Llama3.1-4B/100B tokens：43.29 vs 42.54（+0.75）。

**成本**：AMO 优化器更新 191.47ms（低于 Muon 195.81ms、AdaMuon 241.65ms），峰值显存 61.12GB（与 Muon 并列最低，比 AdaMuon 省 7.88GB），端到端 step time 仅增 3.0–3.8%（前反向 5.82s 主导）；观察阶段精确 SVD 带来低频开销（15.63s/观察步，其中 9.47s 为观测探针），锁定后与 Muon 持平（6.13s/步、0.80M tok/s）。理论内存类与 Muon 同为 P_μ+2P_adam，仅增加 O(|𝒯|) 控制元数据；因不同层类型权重 Σ_i C_{t,i} 差异大，固定名义预算并不固定真实计算量，AMO 优化的是加权目标 Σ_t k_t Σ_i C_{t,i}。

**消融**：观察窗口位置不敏感（37.63–37.77）；n_smp 单调饱和（4/8/16 → 37.65/37.77/37.83）；收缩系数呈倒 U 形（α=0→37.35，α=0.5→37.70，α=0.7→37.77，α=1→37.60），体现偏差-方差权衡；过渡时长 Δ=1 最差（37.27）、100 次之（37.40）、300 最优（37.77）、600 略降（37.58），证实突变切换会破坏动量缓冲。

**预算控制**：r 从 0.8→1.2，Qwen3-0.6B 37.53→37.88，Llama3.1-760M 36.79→37.39；降预算 0.9 仅省 ~8.6% FLOPs 而代价 0.07/0.28 点，增预算 1.2 增 20% FLOPs 仅换 0.11/0.13 点——呈单调但不对称的算力-质量曲线。

**静态系数对比**：族内特异估计一致优于混合估计（12/12 配对全胜，平均 +0.64 / +0.25）；但最优聚合规则依模型而变（Llama 用 Floor-1e-2 得 39.52，Qwen 用 Typical-1e-2 得 40.68），AMO 无需模型专属调参即以 39.69/40.75 超越最佳静态方案。

**粒度消融**：Type×Depth（14 单元）得 39.55，低于算子类型 AMO 的 39.69 但高于 Muon 的 38.91，说明更细粒度未带来额外信号。

**训练动态**：Qwen3-1.7B 上 AMO 自过渡阶段起训练损失持续低于 Muon。

**局限性（作者自述）**：observe-then-commit 无法响应后期几何剧变（周期性重观测或可解）；算子类型未必最优粒度；实验限于 ≤4B 稠密 Transformer，MoE 与更大规模待验证。

Conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：Muon 的 NS 正交化不应被视为"对所有参数矩阵一视同仁的固定例行操作"，而应被视为一种需要按各算子几何特性进行分配的算力资源。实证表明，矩阵级异质性是内在的、结构化的（集中于算子类型层级），且跨类型的难度排序在训练中保持稳定，这正是在固定总预算下进行预算再分配（budget-aware cross-type reallocation）的依据。

AMO 以极简的"观察—规划—过渡—锁定"四步机制实现了：无需额外正交化算力、无需模型专属调参、仅增加 O(|𝒯|) 控制元数据，即可在两个架构族、70M–4B 尺度、标准/延长/持续三种预训练范式下稳定超越统一调度 Muon、AdamW 以及各类静态 NS 系数方案，并优于手工设计的 Type×Depth 细分。

方法论层面，论文也给出三点有价值的负面/边界结论：(1) 数据侧质量课程（单调排序）在所测设置下不可靠，异质性应在优化器侧解决；(2) 层深度不是可靠的分配依据——层间排序会随训练缓慢漂移甚至反转，而算子类型排序则相对持久；(3) 静态预计算系数方案即便按族特异估计也脆弱，因为需在训练前同时确定聚合规则、误差容限与估计池，而在线自适应可绕开这些选择。

从更广视角看，本文把"自适应"从连续重调（可能破坏优化器动态稳定性）改为"一次观测后锁定"，是一个在稳定性与适应性之间的务实折中；其真正贡献不仅在于 +0.5~0.8 的分数增益，更在于提供了一个可复用的分析框架：先用几何统计量刻画异质性的结构与稳定性，再据此选择自适应的粒度与信号来源。后续可探索的方向包括周期性重观测、算子类型与深度的联合建模、MoE 架构下的扩展，以及将 NS 预算分配与实际 FLOPs 加权成本联合优化。

Abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a competitive alternative to AdamW for large-scale pre-training, with orthogonalization via Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations as its core operation. Existing Muon variants apply a uniform NS schedule to all parameter matrices, overlooking possible differences in orthogonalization difficulty and its impact on performance. Through a systematic empirical study, we show that this per-matrix heterogeneity is pervasive and largely determined by matrix geometry, which evolves dynamically across operator types, training stages, and network depths. As a result, uniform NS schedules can lead to uneven orthogonalization quality across the model. Motivated by these findings, we propose Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization (AMO), an observe-then-commit method that measures weight geometry by operator type early in training and then uses these signals to allocate the NS budget for the remainder of training. AMO delivers consistent improvements over uniform-schedule Muon across standard, prolonged, and continual pre-training, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.76 on Llama3.1-1.4B and +0.51 on Qwen3-1.7B in average downstream performance of 12 evaluation tasks.

</details>


### [615] [A Unified Framework for Data-Free One-Step Sampling via Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17808)
*Chenguang Wang,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，把"无数据（data-free）一步采样"统一到 Wasserstein 梯度流（WGF）视角下。核心结论（定理1）：任意标准 f-散度目标 D_f(p‖q) 诱导的速度场都具有通用形式 V(x)=w(r(x))·β(x)，其中 β(x)=∇log(p/q) 是所有目标共享的修正方向，w(r)=r²f″(r) 仅由散度选择决定。据此作者把"反向KL寻峰/正向KL寻覆盖"的经典口号重新解释为"瞬态区域修复偏置"的差异，并导出压缩–弹性恒等式 G_f=∫ p q_t w(r)‖β‖²[κ_t−η_f(r)]dx，给出各散度的显式修复阈值。框架进一步扩展到 Log-Variance（LV）散度（三种参考分布 ν=q / ν=p / ν 独立，含 Z-Annihilator 性质），并落到可实现的 KDE 与（描述性的）归一化流两条路线，实现训练后一步（1-NFE）推理；在高斯混合基准上验证了理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从非归一化目标分布采样是贝叶斯推断、分子模拟与统计物理的核心问题。MCMC、Langevin 动力学、HMC 虽渐近精确却需成百上千次梯度评估；Boltzmann 生成器、随机归一化流、扩散式采样器虽能摊销训练成本，但推理仍需多步网络调用（每样本数百次）。因此"把推理压缩到一次前向（1-NFE）"成为核心目标。现有一步化路线主要有两类：(1) 蒸馏（consistency 蒸馏、自蒸馏、He et al. 的 reverse diffusive KL），它们在训练期仍继承多步框架，且缺乏关于"一步更新如何修复多模态欠覆盖区域"的原则性解释；(2) Drifting Model（Deng et al., 2026），它利用训练期推前分布的演化把 WGF 的欧拉步摊销进生成器，推理期完全无迭代，但原始形式局限于"有数据"设定，需要目标分布的真实样本，无法直接迁移到仅能访问能量 E(x) 或其梯度 ∇E(x) 的 data-free 场景。更根本地，drifting field 与底层散度目标之间的关系从未被系统刻画，不同目标如何在多模态地形上重新分配"修复努力"更是空白。本文正是要填补这两点：把 data-free 一步采样纳入统一的 WGF 理论框架，并给出可解释、可实现的方法。

Method: 【理论部分】(1) 统一漂移场：在 P₂(ℝ^d) 上以 F(q)=D_f(p‖q) 为泛函，由 Otto 微积分与一阶变分 δD_f/δq = f(r)−r f′(r)（r=p/q）出发，得 V(x)=r²f″(r)·∇log r(x)=w(r)β(x)（定理1，附录B给出完整推导）。据此列出 Reverse KL (w≡1)、Forward KL (w=r)、χ² (w=2r²)、Tsallis T_α (w=αr^α) 等权重表。(2) Log-Variance 散度（属 f-散度族之外）：定义 L(q)=Var_ν[log r̃]，r̃=Z·r；由"Z-Annihilator"性质，中心化对数比消去未知的 log Z。三种参考分布分别导出：ν=q（双耦合，前因子 2[1−z_q(x)] 可能反向，最不稳健）、ν=p（目标加权，2(p/q)[1+z_p]，最贴合目标修复，但需对 p 的期望做重要性采样）、ν 与 q 无关（固定参考，额外出现形状修正项 γ(x)=z_ν∇log(ν/q)；当 ν=q_sg 时 γ=0，退化为 2β）。（3）区域修复理论：定义欠覆盖几何区域 Ω_{δ,ε}={p≥δ, q_t≤ε} 与软欠覆盖质量 U_{δ,ε}(q)=∫p·1{p≥δ}[ε−q]_+dx；命题3 给出一步欧拉更新的一阶变分 U(q_{t+h})=U(q_t)−h·G_V+o(h)，G_V=∫_Ω p[−∇·(q_t V)]dx，G_V>0 是"一步改善"的充分条件（积性而非逐点条件）；命题4 给出压缩–弹性恒等式 G_f=∫_Ω p q_t w(r)‖β‖²[κ_t−η_f(r)]dx，其中几何压缩指数 κ_t=−∇·(q_tβ)/(q_t‖β‖²)，散度弹性 η_f=r w′(r)/w(r)（RKL=0、FKL=1、χ²=2、Tsallis=α），几何直觉是欠覆盖区域的净向内通量。命题5 证明 w(r)>0 时连续统不动点必有 p=q，故各 f-散度共享同一渐近目标。(4) 理论诊断：证明 SVGD 的最优扰动方向等于漂移场的核平滑版本 φ*=E_{y∼q}[k(y,x)β(y)]，说明 SVGD 是本框架的 RKHS 平滑极限；并用附录D 说明原 Drifting Model 的 Laplace 均值漂移（用未归一化位移）只是 Reverse-KL 原则的启发式实现，非精确 KDE 分数恒等式。

【实现部分】统一"采样器–估计器"接口：由能量梯度得 ∇log p=−∇E，由当前粒子估计 (log q, ∇log q)。KDE 路线用小批量核密度估计（给出 RBF 的精确分数恒等式 ∇log q̂=(2/τ)ΣW_j(x_j−x) 与 Laplace 的单位位移版本），并可选 Sinkhorn 双随机归一化替代行 softmax，以避免小带宽下的"排斥塌缩"（附录G 给出 τ→0 塌缩分析与 log-space 迭代）。NF 路线：精确流用换元公式解析给出 (log q, ∇log q)，或用辅助 NF 密度模型（继承其表示误差）。目标特化：f-散度族用 r̃=exp(−E−ℓ) 与批内自归一化重加权 w̄_i=w̃_i/mean(w̃) 吸收未知 Z；LV 采用中心化对数比门控启发式 V_i=2(1+[m_i−m̄_ν]_+)β̃_i（保留 Z-Annihilator、避免方向反转，并给出含批归一化权重的变体）。训练沿用 Drifting Model 的 stop-gradient 一步目标 L(θ)=E‖f_θ(ε)−sg(f_θ(ε)+V(f_θ(ε)))‖²（算法1）。

Result: 【实验设置】5 个高斯混合基准：GMM-8、GMM-40（2D）、GMM-Manymodes（d=8，权重 3:1 不均衡）、GMM-2hard-16/32（双峰间距 2√d=8.0/11.3，测试跨模态桥接）；指标为 MMD、精确 LP 的 W₁、高维 Sinkhorn 的 W₂、TVD、KL_mode 与模态覆盖率；3 个随机种子，主要用 Laplacian KDE。

【主结果】2D：GMM-8 上两目标均 8/8 全覆盖，RKL W₁=0.259±0.009 vs LV 0.270±0.014（差异在方差内）；GMM-40 上均 40/40 覆盖，RKL 传输代价更优（W₁ 3.306±0.293 vs 4.543±1.560，MMD 0.049 vs 0.075）。高维：GMM-Manymodes 两者全覆盖，RKL W₂ 更低（1.901 vs 2.016），但 LV 的 MMD（0.066 vs 0.174）与模态权重保真度（KL_mode 0.052 vs 0.213）明显更优；GMM-2hard-16 两者均成功跨模态桥接，LV 模态权重更准（0.050 vs 0.086）；GMM-2hard-32 上 LV 在所有种子下塌缩到单一模态（覆盖 1/2），仅 RKL 有效（W₂=0.849±0.266）。结论：无统一占优者——RKL 更适合大间隙长程传输与稳定性，LV 在估计器足够可靠时改善模态权重保真但在大间隙下失效。

【理论诊断】Figure 2 在收敛的 GMM-8 检查点上验证分解：β 场对各散度完全相同，w(r) 与 V=w·β 的幅度图不同；压缩–弹性分解显示收敛附近 κ_t 普遍接近 0，RKL（η=0）有微弱正的 G_f=0.038，而 FKL（η=1，G_f=−0.286<0）与 χ²（η=2，G_f≪0）的阈值已不被满足。Figure 3 的冻结一步探针（以 N(0,0.64I) 粒子代理早期训练态，δ=ε=0.01，Laplace KDE τ=0.5）算出 G_V=0.0474>0，且一步欧拉步（h=0.05）后 Ω 区域可见收缩，验证命题3/4。

【消融】吸引权重 a_attr^T 在 {0.10…0.60} 内均保持 40/40 覆盖，W₁ 在基线 0.25 处最小（3.18），过大（≥0.40）同时恶化 MMD 与 W₁；带宽 τ 影响更尖锐：τ=0.3 给出最低 MMD（0.023）但 W₁ 变差（4.91），τ=4.0 完全退化仅覆盖 3/40（7.5%），说明 τ 是更"安全攸关"的超参。KDE 变体：Gaussian 在简单低维目标上传输代价更优，但在 GMM-2hard-16/32 上直接发散，Laplace 因重尾抗过平滑而在跨模态场景更稳健。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是把"一步采样"从各家自定义的启发式蒸馏/漂移技巧，收敛到一个统一的 Wasserstein 梯度流图景：所有标准 f-散度共享同一修正方向 β=∇log(p/q)，仅通过目标相关的标量权重 w(r) 重加权；散度之间的差别因此不再是渐近目标不同（w>0 时不动点必为 p=q），而是"瞬态区域修复偏置"不同，这一点由压缩–弹性恒等式给出定量刻画（阈值 0/1/2/α）。框架还把 f-散度之外的 LV 散度纳入同一模板（Z-Annihilator 消除配分函数障碍，并说明三种参考分布如何改变漂移结构），并给出一条可直接落地的一步数据自由训练管线（KDE/NF 估计 (log q, ∇log q) + 目标特化权重 + stop-gradient 一步目标），训练后单次前向即可采样。实验结论是审慎的：无普适最优目标；RKL 在大模态间隙与高维下更稳健，LV 在估计器可靠时改善模态权重保真；密度估计（尤其 KDE 带宽）是 data-free 场景的实际瓶颈。

局限与展望：NF 路线仅描述未做完整实证；KDE 的 O(N²) 成本靠固定大小参考批缓解；理论结果为局部/结构性，尚未给出摊销动力学的收敛或稳定性保证，实践中充分条件难验证。后续方向包括完成 NF 实现、基于当前采样器几何的自适应目标选择、高维能量的更好密度估计、条件/结构化采样扩展，以及更锐利的收敛与稳定性保证。

Abstract: We develop a unified theoretical framework for data-free one-step sampling from unnormalized target distributions based on Wasserstein gradient flows. For a broad class of standard f-divergence objectives, we show that the induced velocity field admits the universal form $\mathbf{V}(x)=w(r(x))\,β(x)$, where $β(x)=\nabla \log (p(x)/q(x))$ is shared across objectives and $w$ is determined solely by the choice of divergence. This decomposition shows that standard f-divergence drifts share the same asymptotic target distribution $p$ and differ primarily in how they redistribute transient repair effort across under-covered regions. To formalize this distinction, we derive a one-step regional-response theory for a soft under-coverage functional and obtain a compression--elasticity identity that links divergence choice to the geometry of mass transport into under-covered regions. We further extend the framework beyond the f-divergence family to the Log-Variance (LV) divergence, analyze how the reference distribution alters the resulting drift structure, and motivate a practical LV-inspired surrogate for data-free training. Based on this theory, we instantiate the framework with a KDE-based implementation and describe a complementary normalizing-flow route, enabling one-step inference after training. Experiments on multimodal Gaussian-mixture benchmarks are consistent with the theoretical predictions and demonstrate effective one-step sampling on these targets.

</details>


### [616] [One Model, Two Roles: Emergent Specialization in a Shared Recurrent Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17811)
*Jucheng Shen,Barbara Su,Anastasios Kyrillidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Asymmetric Input Recurrence (AIR)：在双状态递归 Transformer 中共享同一套参数，唯一内置差异是 L-更新注入编码输入 x̃ 而 H-更新不注入。在 Sudoku-Extreme 与 Maze 上，共享模型自发形成稳定的功能分化——z_H 是「完全承诺的提案状态」，z_L 是「保留局部不确定、可变的中间结构」；只要给共享模型一个可辨识的「状态身份信号」（输入注入不对称，或可分离的 level token），就会诱导出这种分工并提升准确率（L 更局部、H 更全局的注意力模式）。结论是：参数模块化并非专门化的必要条件，明确的状态身份信号才是关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HRM（Wang et al., 2025）用两套独立参数模块维护高层/低层隐状态，TRM（Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2025）则用单一共享权重的递归网络替代之。由此产生一个核心问题：当同一模型被复用于两个隐状态时，它会学到不同的计算角色，还是以完全相同的方式处理两个状态？这决定了「功能专门化」是否必须依赖独立的参数模块——若共享计算在获得稳定的「我正在更新哪个状态」的信号后仍能自发分化出分工，则对设计更高效的推理架构与理解循环网络的归纳偏置具有直接意义。此外，与结构性模块化（如 NMN、RIM）不同，AIR 严格保证循环模型参数共享，因此任何分工都必须从训练中涌现，隔离了「涌现模块化」这一问题的核心变量。

Method: AIR 保留 TRM 的共享递归模型 f(·;θ)，配合 HRM 的一步截断梯度（Williams & Peng, 1990）：每个高层周期交错 C_L 次 L-更新与 1 次 H-更新，重复 C_H 次，默认 C_L=C_H=2（子步模式 L,L,H,L,L,H），前四个子步不反传，梯度仅通过最后一次 L-更新与 H-更新计算；采用 ACT 风格 halting（最多 16 周期，探索概率 0.1）。更新规则为 z_L←f(z_L+z_H+α_L x̃)，z_H←f(z_H+z_L+α_H x̃)，默认 (α_L,α_H)=(1,0)。共享 Transformer 为 4 层、8 头、D=512、MLP 扩展 4、RoPE；输出头同时用于训练监督与中间态解码，损失仅直接监督 z_H，z_L 通过递归被间接塑造；z_H、z_L 初始化为固定向量 h_0、l_0 的广播副本。训练沿用 HRM 配方：AdamATan2，学习率 1e-4，权重衰减 1.0，全局 batch 768，2000 步 warmup，stablemax 交叉熵，Sudoku 训练 20,000 epochs，数据 1,000 谜题并做 1,000× 增强。

分析手段包括四类：(1) 解码 rollout——用测试时同一输出头解码每个子步的 z_H 与 z_L；(2) 注入不对称消融——参数化 (n_L,n_H) 与不对称度 Δ=|n_L−n_H|；(3) level-token 对照——在对称基线 L2x_H2x 上加入可学习层级 token，分 Addition（逐元素相加）、Prepend (strip)（位置 0 前置、参与自注意力、末层后剥离）、Prepend (no strip)（不剥离、跨周期累积）三种；另有算子形式对照（线性/非线性/符号翻转/Hadamard）与单状态消融（合并为一个 z，仅周期性注入）；(4) 冻结实验——固定一态更新、度量另一态的「content change」（相邻子步间解码 token 发生变化的位点数）；(5) 注意力分析——比较首个 L-更新与首个 H-更新（周期 2,4,…,15），计算邻域注意力质量差 Δ_nbr、熵差 Δ_ent、违规注意力差 Δ_viol，以及 Maze 上按邻域大小归一的密度对比 Δρ^(k)（k=4,8,5×5），并用「邻域内违规格 vs 非违规格」的每格注意力密度做控制以剥离纯局部性解释。任务为 Sudoku-Extreme（9×9、17 个提示、BLANK 标记未决）与 Maze（30×30、PAD 标记未决）；Sudoku 测试集 422,786 题，Maze 1,000 题；准确率为峰值/早停精确匹配，5 种子均值±标准差。总算力约 500 GPU·小时。

Result: （1）涌现专门化：非对称 AIR 的 rollout 在两任务上均显示稳定分化——z_H 在每个子步都解码出完整候选解（即使错误），呈「完全承诺」；z_L 部分位置保持未决（Sudoku 用 BLANK、Maze 用 PAD），且未决位置跨子步迁移。对称变体 Lx_Hx 中该分化几乎消失：z_L 不再出现可见 BLANK/PAD 区域，z_H 也失去早期承诺性。（2）注入不对称消融（Table 1）：Sudoku 上 Δ>0 组均值 ≈59.1%，Δ=0 组 ≈51.5%（约 8 点落差）；Maze 上 ≈73.1% vs ≈69.9%。最优 AIR 变体以 HRM 一半参数量达到 Sudoku 60.0%、Maze 75.6%，超过双网络 HRM 基线（55.0%/74.5%）。（3）level-token 对照（Table 2，基于对称 L2x_H2x 的 50.9%）：Addition 无效（50.0%），Prepend (strip) 恢复大部分差距（57.5%），Prepend (no strip) 更差（47.8%）。附录 B 从注意力 logit 展开解释：Addition 把层级向量均匀混入每个内容 token，产生依赖内容与位置的交叉项，使 τ_m W_Q/W_K/W_V 无法被单独读取；而 Prepend-and-strip 提供位置独立、可被注意力读取且每次调用重置的标记。（4）算子形式控制：线性、非线性、符号翻转、Hadamard 变体均在 58.3–59.9%，说明注入的「形式」非关键。（5）单状态消融（Appendix D）：单 z 周期注入仅 51.1%，与对称双态相当、远低于 60.0%，说明仅周期性输入注入不足以引发专门化，需要两个分离的存储缓冲。（6）冻结实验（content change，5 种子）：Sudoku 冻结 z_H 使 z_L 总变化从 1235 降至 323，冻结 z_L 使 z_H 从 275 升至 551；Maze 冻结任一态都增大另一态变化（z_L：1290→2305；z_H：825→2880）。对称变体不呈现这种方向一致的模式。冻结任一态在两任务上均使最终准确率塌至 0%（未冻结为 55.1%/71.0%），说明两态对最终输出均不可或缺。（7）注意力机制：L-更新一致更局部——Sudoku 上 Δ_nbr、Δ_ent 在所有层与查询类均为正，最深层 control 格 Δ_nbr=0.24（L 的邻域注意力质量比 H 高约 47%）；Maze 上所有邻域尺寸 k、层、查询类的 Δρ^(k)>0 且 Δ_ent>0，且效应在最小邻域最强、随邻域扩大衰减。违规敏感信号只在 Sudoku 出现：Δ_viol 在第 0 层为负（−0.018）、第 2–3 层转正（+0.028/+0.037），且邻域内每格密度控制仍为正（+0.0025/+0.0046），说明超出纯局部性；Maze 的邻域内控制在各层均近零，其误差格额外质量可完全由局部性解释。差异具时间持续性（跨周期 2–15 稳定），排除单周期伪影。

Conclusion: 在受控的两状态循环推理设定中，共享权重的递归 Transformer 确实能够自发形成稳定且相互关联的功能角色，无需参数层面的模块化；决定性因素是共享计算能否获得一个清晰且与递归内容解耦的「状态身份信号」——既可由输入注入的不对称性提供，也可由结构上可分离的 level token 提供。该发现提示循环架构的专门化更依赖状态身份信号而非参数分离，对设计「一模型多角色」的高效推理架构具有启发意义。局限：仅在两个合成、完全可观测的网格组合任务上验证；仅 4 层共享 Transformer、两个隐状态、默认 C_L=C_H=2 的调度；机制证据在 Sudoku 上最强，注意力权重只是计算的部分视角；能否推广到更深模块、不同调度、自然语言推理、连续域或部分可观测环境仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Can a shared-weight recurrent Transformer develop distinct internal roles without being partitioned into separate modules? We study this in Asymmetric Input Recurrence (AIR), a minimal two-state reasoning architecture in which the same Transformer model is reused for both updates (per literature, L and H) and the only built-in difference in the update rule is that the encoded input is injected during L-updates but not H-updates. Across Sudoku-Extreme and Maze, decoded rollouts reveal a consistent split: $\zH$ behaves like a fully committed proposal state, whereas $\zL$ retains local uncertainty and shifting intermediate structure. Freeze experiments show that this split is, in practice, related to the model's state dynamics: in Sudoku, freezing $\zH$ reduces $\zL$'s content changes whereas freezing $\zL$ increases $\zH$'s, while in Maze, freezing either state increases content changes in the other state. Ablations show that to induce specialization, the shared model needs to be able to tell the two update types apart, either from input injection asymmetry or from a separate level token. Mechanistically, attention analysis shows that L-updates are consistently more local than H-updates in both Sudoku and Maze. Together, these results show that, in a two-state recurrent setting, a clear state-identity signal can induce stable, related functional roles inside a shared-parameter recurrent Transformer. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/juchengshen/air}{\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/juchengshen/air}}.

</details>


### [617] [Content-Style Identification via Differential Independence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17827)
*Subash Timilsina,Hoang-Son Nguyen,Sagar Shrestha,Xiao Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"内容-风格微分独立性"(CSDI)这一新的结构条件,用生成器雅可比中内容子空间与风格子空间正交(而非统计独立、也非雅可比稀疏)来保证非配对多域数据中内容与风格的可辨识性;并给出基于 Hutchinson 迹估计与 VJP 噪声探测的可扩展随机正则项,落地为基于 StyleGAN2-ADA 的 CSDI-GAN,在双域 MNIST、AFHQ、CelebA-HQ 上验证了理论与反事实生成、域翻译的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多域数据通常建模为共享内容变量 c 与域特定风格变量 s^(n) 的非线性混合,但在无配对样本时内容/风格存在本质的可辨识性歧义:仅做分布匹配会得到分布正确但语义纠缠的解。已有工作依赖两类较强条件:(1) 内容与风格(块式或分量式)的统计独立性(如 I-StyleGAN、B.I. GAN),这在现实场景中常不成立(如光照依赖物体几何、生物学变异依赖细胞状态,单细胞数据尤为明显);(2) 生成器雅可比的稀疏影响/非重叠支撑假设(如基于雅可比稀疏的反事实生成方法),该条件在变量密集影响观测的场景下过强。此外 VAE 类框架不适合高分辨率图像合成,需要能支撑高维生成的实用实现。因此核心问题是:能否在不假设统计独立、也不假设雅可比稀疏的前提下,从非配对多域数据中辨识出内容与风格?

Method: 1) 条件与学习目标:提出假设 3.1(CSDI),即 R(J_c g) ⊥ R(J_s^(n) g),即数据流形切空间被分解为正交的内容切子空间与风格切子空间;学习目标为同时满足跨域分布匹配(3b)与内容/风格雅可比块正交约束(3c),并要求生成器可逆。2) 理论:假设 3.3(域变异性,要求存在可区分的域对使风格分布充分多样)下,定理 3.4 证明内容与风格在可逆变换意义下可辨识(内容 ĉ=γ(c),风格 ŝ^(n)=δ(s^(n)),后者额外要求风格雅可比满秩 rank(J_s g)=d_S);附录 A 依据 Zimmermann 等的正则密度双射命题说明在隐层维度正确时分布匹配隐含生成器双射;定理 3.6 给出鲁棒版:当最小主角满足 ≥ π/2−ξ 时,内容仍严格可辨识,而风格中混入的内容量满足 ‖J_c δ‖₂ ≤ [sin ξ / σ_min(J_ŝ ĝ)]·‖J_c g‖₂,即依赖非正交程度 sin ξ、内容雅可比幅度与学习风格雅可比的条件数。3) 可扩展实现(CSDI-GAN):以 GAN 为主干(AFHQ/CelebA-HQ 用 StyleGAN2-ADA 合成网络,去掉映射网络,以可训练内容编码器 e_C 与各域风格编码器 e_S^(n) 替代);通过共享噪声块 r_C1 构造统计依赖的内容/风格(符合 Reichenbach 共同原因原理且与 CSDI 相容);损失 = GAN 损失 + λ_inv 可逆性损失(编码器-解码器往返重建)+ λ_orth 正交正则。正则项为 ‖J_ŝ^T J_c‖_F² /(‖J_c‖_F²‖J_ŝ‖_F²+ε),近似尺度不变并排除雅可比退化为零的平凡解;用 Hutchinson 迹估计 + 随机噪声探测 v~N(0,I) 的 VJP(∇_c⟨ĝ,v⟩)无偏估计各项,把 O(d) 次反向传播降为 O(K)(K≪d),内存降低约 (d_C+d_S) 倍,避免显式存储 d×d_C / d×d_S 雅可比;该方法不涉及有限差分的多步长超参搜索。4) 域翻译采用两步 GAN 反演(用预训练 VGG-16 作为散度度量)提取源域内容与目标域风格后重新组合。

Result: 双域 MNIST(内容=数字身份,风格=域1数字颜色/域2背景颜色,通过标签相关允许集 p=0.8 制造可控依赖):CSDI-GAN 得到最佳 FID 23.80 / LPIPS 0.3321,优于无 L_orth 变体(27.45/0.2674)与 B.I. GAN(26.25/0.2685);基于真值标签的 R² 评测中风格 R² 达 0.8995(BI 0.7338,无正交项 0.5618),内容 R² 0.7675 保持竞争力。真实数据:生成任务 AFHQ FID 4.4 / LPIPS 0.4452(vs B.I. GAN 5.2/0.3995,I-StyleGAN 5.6/0.3436),CelebA-HQ FID 4.3 / LPIPS 0.3392(vs 4.6/0.2628、4.8/0.2799);翻译任务 AFHQ FID 7.1 / LPIPS 0.4392(vs B.I. GAN 10.5/0.4107、StarGANv2 15.0、I-StyleGAN 17.6),CelebA-HQ FID 12.9(vs 24.6/14.3)。定性结果显示基线在风格保持上失败(如猫→野生域生成狮/狼/豹,I-StyleGAN 保留猫耳形状的伪相关),去掉 L_orth 的 CSDI-GAN 同样失败,验证正交正则的关键作用。超参敏感性显示 λ_inv、λ_orth、K、ε 在中等范围稳定,置零或过大均退化;计算开销温和(AFHQ 720K 迭代单卡 V100:30.09 h / 14.2 GB vs StyleGAN 23.11 h / 9.38 GB)。

Conclusion: 内容与风格的可辨识性不必依赖统计独立性或雅可比稀疏性:只要生成器中内容与风格引起的无穷小变化在数据流形上正交(微分独立性),配合跨域分布匹配即可获得内容与风格在可逆变换下的严格辨识;即使正交仅近似成立,内容仍可辨识,风格中的内容残留量可由主角偏差显式界定。配套的 Hutchinson/VJP 随机正交正则把该结构约束转化为可在高分辨率图像上扩展训练的可计算损失,为反事实生成与域翻译提供了更少假设、更好指标的实用方案。作者指出局限在于目前仅基于 GAN 实现(训练不稳定、可能模式坍塌),将 CSDI 推广到扩散与流匹配模型因架构与训练机制差异仍是非平凡的开放方向;代码已开源。

Abstract: Generative analysis often models multi-domain observations as nonlinear mixtures of domain-invariant content variables and domain-specific style variables. Identifying both factors from unpaired domains enables tasks such as domain transfer and counterfactual data generation. Prior work establishes identifiability under (block-wise) statistical independence between content and style, or via sparse Jacobian assumptions on the nonlinear mixing function, but such conditions can be restrictive in practice. In this work, we introduce content-style differential independence (CSDI), an alternative structural condition requiring that infinitesimal variations in content and style induce orthogonal directions on the data manifold, thereby enabling identifiability even when content and style are dependent and the Jacobian is dense. We operationalize this condition through a blockwise orthogonality constraint on the Jacobian subspaces associated with content and style. To support high-dimensional generative models, we design a stochastic regularizer based on numerical Jacobian approximation, enabling scalable training in settings such as high-resolution image generation. Experiments across multiple datasets corroborate the identifiability analysis and demonstrate practical benefits on counterfactual generation and domain translation.

</details>


### [618] [Efficient Bilevel Optimization for Meta Label Correction in Noisy Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17833)
*Ba Hoang Anh Nguyen,Viet Cuong Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Training a deep neural network with noisy labels could reduce data annotation cost but may introduce noise into the learned model. In meta label correction approaches, an additional meta model besides the main model is trained with a small, clean dataset to correct the large, noisy dataset. However, the update of the meta model requires the computation of hypergradients at the inner step of the main model which signif- icantly increases the computational cost. To improve the training efficiency, we first introduce the dynamic barrier gradient descent into standard meta label correction. While this naive extenstion is able to speed up the training process to approximately first- order complexity, it lacks mechanisms to prevent the leakage of noisy signals to the main model and to stabilize the learning of the meta model. Based on this observation, we propose the EBOMLC method, which is designed with three key improvements including one-step inner loop update, mixture upper loss and alignment- aware dynamic barrier. Empirical results on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate that EBOMLC consistently outperforms other baselines, especially under high noise rate settings, while reducing training time of the meta label correction approach.

### [619] [Balancing Knowledge Distillation for Imbalance Learning with Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17839)
*Anh B. H. Nguyen,Ba Tho Phan,Viet Cuong Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a high capacity teacher to a compact student using a mixture of hard and soft losses. On imbalanced data, a fixed weighting between hard and soft losses becomes brittle the learning process. Recent studies try to reweight these components in long-tailed settings. However, most of these meth- ods do not adapt weights at the sample-wise level and do not take into account the students behavior during training. To address this, we pro- pose BiKD - a bilevel framework that dynamically balances hard and soft losses for each sample. We employ a weight generation network that produces adaptive per-sample weights, guided by a small balanced vali- dation set. The student is now trained with an unconstrained combina- tion of weighted hard and soft losses, allowing the student to relax both terms. We further propose a multi-step SGD strategy to optimize the weight model more accurately and efficiently. Experiments on long-tailed CIFAR-10/100 show that our approach surpasses recent balanced distil- lation methods across imbalance factors.

### [620] [SNLP: Layer-Parallel Inference via Structured Newton Corrections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17842)
*Ligong Han,Kai Xu,Hao Wang,Akash Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Autoregressive language models execute Transformer layers sequentially, creating a latency bottleneck that is not removed by conventional tensor or pipeline parallelism. We study whether this layerwise dependency can be relaxed by treating the hidden-state trace across layers as the solution of a nonlinear residual equation and solving it with parallel Newton-style updates. While this view is principled, exact Newton corrections require expensive Jacobian-vector products and naive fixed-point iterations are unstable on trained Transformers. We introduce Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP), a training and inference framework that replaces exact layer Jacobians with cheap architecture-induced surrogate dynamics. In residual Transformers, this yields Identity Newton (IDN), where the correction reduces to a prefix-sum-like update; in mHC-style architectures, HC Newton (HCN) uses the model's residual mixing matrix. We further introduce SNLP-aware regularization, which trains models to make one or a few structured Newton iterations accurately approximate the sequential forward. Experiments on nanochat-scale Transformers show that SNLP regularization improves layer-parallel compatibility and can also improve standard sequential perplexity, reducing baseline PPL by 4.7%-23.4%. At inference time, SNLP combined with layer fusion and chunkwise decomposition achieves practical wall-clock speedups: on a 0.5B Nanochat model, it reaches 2.3x speedup while still improving PPL by 6.1%. These results suggest that layer-parallel inference is not merely a numerical approximation to sequential execution, but can act as a useful solver-induced inference bias. We also characterize limitations: off-the-shelf pretrained models are less amenable to this procedure, and exact convergence recovers the sequential computation rather than providing monotonic inference-time scaling.

Abstract: Autoregressive language models execute Transformer layers sequentially, creating a latency bottleneck that is not removed by conventional tensor or pipeline parallelism. We study whether this layerwise dependency can be relaxed by treating the hidden-state trace across layers as the solution of a nonlinear residual equation and solving it with parallel Newton-style updates. While this view is principled, exact Newton corrections require expensive Jacobian-vector products and naive fixed-point iterations are unstable on trained Transformers. We introduce Structured Newton Layer Parallelism (SNLP), a training and inference framework that replaces exact layer Jacobians with cheap architecture-induced surrogate dynamics. In residual Transformers, this yields Identity Newton (IDN), where the correction reduces to a prefix-sum-like update; in mHC-style architectures, HC Newton (HCN) uses the model's residual mixing matrix. We further introduce SNLP-aware regularization, which trains models to make one or a few structured Newton iterations accurately approximate the sequential forward. Experiments on nanochat-scale Transformers show that SNLP regularization improves layer-parallel compatibility and can also improve standard sequential perplexity, reducing baseline PPL by 4.7%-23.4%. At inference time, SNLP combined with layer fusion and chunkwise decomposition achieves practical wall-clock speedups: on a 0.5B Nanochat model, it reaches 2.3x speedup while still improving PPL by 6.1%. These results suggest that layer-parallel inference is not merely a numerical approximation to sequential execution, but can act as a useful solver-induced inference bias. We also characterize limitations: off-the-shelf pretrained models are less amenable to this procedure, and exact convergence recovers the sequential computation rather than providing monotonic inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [621] [Learning over Positive and Negative Edges with Contrastive Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17854)
*Peter Pao-Huang,Charilaos I. Kanatsoulis,Michael Bereket,Jure Leskovec*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Conventional approaches to learning on graphs involve message passing along existing (i.e., positive) edges to update node features. However, these approaches often disregard the potentially valuable information contained in the absence (i.e., negative) of edges. Here, we theoretically analyze the value of negative edges in graph representations and prove that in settings of low label rates, high homophily, and high edge density, access to negative edges provides significant information gain over using only positive edges. Motivated by this insight, we introduce Contrastive Message Passing (CMP), a general message passing architecture that enable graph neural network layers to reason over positive and negative edges. By imposing soft positive semidefinite constraints on the learnable weights, our approach differentially applies similarity-preserving transformations to positively connected nodes and dissimilarity-inducing transformations to negatively connected nodes. Over simulated and real datasets in varying data regimes, CMP consistently outperforms baselines in low-label settings when negative edges are informative.

### [622] [$\boldsymbol{f}$-OPD: Stabilizing Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation with Freshness-Aware Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17862)
*Xianwei Chen,Shimin Zhang,Jibin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Scaling on-policy distillation (OPD) for large language models (LLMs) confronts a fundamental tension: asynchronous execution is necessary for system efficiency, but structurally deviates from the ideal on-policy objective. To address this challenge, we theoretically decompose the objective discrepancy into rollout drift and supervision drift, capturing staleness in student rollout and teacher context, respectively. Building on this, we introduce a sample-level freshness score that quantifies the reliability of a buffered sample with respect to the on-policy objective. Guided by this signal, we further propose f-OPD, a novel framework that adaptively regulates stale-sample influence and constrains policy drift accumulated under asynchronous training. Across reasoning, tool-use, and coding-agent tasks of increasing interaction horizon, f-OPD consistently achieves task performance comparable to synchronous optimization while largely retaining the throughput advantages of asynchronous execution. Our results establish the first recipe for achieving a performance-efficiency trade-off in OPD, paving the way for long-horizon agentic post-training at scale.

### [623] [DAD4TS: Data-Augmentation-Oriented Diffusion Model for Time-Series Forecasting with Small-Scale Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17866)
*Masahiro Suzuki,Bohui Xia,Hiroto Yamamoto,Masanori Miyahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Small-scale data is a critical problem in time-series forecasting tasks. Data augmentation is an effective strategy for this task, but it has a limitation in generating meaningful data. To address this limitation, we propose DAD4TS, a diffusion-model-based data augmentation method with reinforcement learning, designed for time-series forecasting with small-scale data. In DAD4TS, a data generator is simultaneously trained with a time-series model and controlled by a reinforcement learning model to efficiently generate samples that improve the forecast accuracy of the time-series model. To support small-scale data, we use mathematical methods instead of conventional VAE methods to train the diffusion model by projecting the time-series data into the geometric space. We validated the effectiveness of DAD4TS with seven comparative methods through qualitative and quantitative experiments on six real-world datasets and eight time-series models. As a result, DAD4TS was validated on five datasets.

### [624] [Attention Sinks and Outliers in Attention Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17887)
*Haozheng Luo,Haoran Dai,Shaoyang Zhang,Xi Chen,Eric Hanchen Jiang,Yijiang Li,Jingyuan Huang,Chenghao Qiu,Chenwei Xu,Zhenyu Pan,Haotian Zhang,Binghui Wang,Yan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We propose OASIS, an outlier- and sink-aware technique built on inter-layer null signaling. As AttnResidual architectures introduce an additional depth-wise normalization channel, they improve inter-layer routing flexibility but also exacerbate attention sinks, activation outliers, and the resulting degradation in inference stability and quantization robustness. OASIS addresses this issue by introducing a Softmax1-based null space and coupling token-level null evidence to depth routing through an inter-layer null signal, thereby reducing sink-dominated routing and improving structural robustness. Theoretically, we show that the dual-normalization design of AttnResidual intensifies sink formation and quantization brittleness. Experimentally, we compare OASIS against five baselines on three real-world datasets and observe consistent improvements in both attention sink and post-quantization performance. Notably, OASIS achieves an average reduction of 9.26% in maximum infinity norm and 2.60% in average kurtosis across the evaluated settings, while lowering perplexity by 75.85% under W8A8 and improving GSM8K Pass@1 by 12.42% under W4A4.

### [625] [CoX-MoE: Coalesced Expert Execution for High-Throughput MoE Inference with AMX-Enabled CPU-GPU Co-Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17889)
*Mu-Young Son,Yi Chen,Seungjae Yoo,Soongyu Choi Joo-Young Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture improves computational efficiency via sparse expert activation, but throughput-oriented inference faces substantial GPU memory pressure due to a significant parameter size and intermediate data. Prior works attempt to mitigate this using expert offloading with micro-batching or by offloading computation to the CPU. However, the fragmented workload resulting from micro-batching degrades operational intensity, causing expert execution to become memory-bound. Meanwhile, CPU offloading is constrained by slow PCIe transfers and its limited applicability to attention computation in the decode stage. Consequently, these inefficiencies prevent effective system utilization, severely restricting the end-to-end throughput of MoE inference.
  To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoX-MoE, an Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX)-enabled CPU-GPU collaborative system that comprehensively optimizes MoE inference by combining coalesced expert execution with strategic workload orchestration for higher throughput. CoX-MoE introduces (i) a coalescing-aware orchestration policy to jointly optimize resource allocation by adopting ordinary batch, instead of micro-batch, for expert computation and selective attention offloading, and (ii) a static expert-aware stratification scheme that pre-assigns frequently activated experts to the GPU, mitigating PCIe transfer overhead and balancing workload for the CPU and GPU during inference. Compared to state-of-the-art frameworks, CoX-MoE delivers significant gains, achieving up to 7.1x and 2.4x higher throughput than FlexGen and MoE-Lightning, respectively.

### [626] [Lightweight Gaussian Process Inference in C++ on Metal and CUDA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17898)
*Yu-Hsueh Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Gaussian process (GP) inference in Python is dominated by libraries such as GPyTorch and GPflow, which are built on deep-learning frameworks and inherit their dispatch overhead and dependency footprint. We present LightGP, a dependency-free C++17 library for GP regression with Python bindings, supporting Apple Metal and NVIDIA CUDA backends alongside tuned CPU paths via Apple Accelerate and OpenBLAS. LightGP provides four inference paths -- exact Cholesky, matrix-free conjugate gradients, sparse variational free energy, and structured kernel interpolation with FFT -- covering problems from $N{=}100$ to $N{=}500{,}000$. On an Apple M4, LightGP CPU is 2.6--8.7$\times$ faster than GPyTorch CPU for exact GP and ${\sim}1.5\times$ faster for sparse GP at every scale tested. On an NVIDIA RTX~3060, LightGP CUDA is 2.3--6.7$\times$ faster than GPyTorch CUDA for exact GP up to $N{=}2{,}048$, with GPyTorch closing the gap at $N{=}4{,}096$. A fused matrix-free kernel-vector product on Metal achieves 32$\times$ over the explicit path at $N{=}20{,}000$ with $O(N)$ memory, and an FFT-accelerated SKI matvec via Accelerate vDSP runs in sub-millisecond time at $N{=}200{,}000$. LightGP compiles as a single static library with zero external dependencies and is installable via \texttt{pip install lightgp

### [627] [DCFold: Efficient Protein Structure Generation with Single Forward Pass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17899)
*Zhe Zhang,Yuanning Feng,Yuxuan Song,Keyue Qiu,Hao Zhou,Wei-Ying Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AlphaFold3 introduces a diffusion-based architecture that elevates protein structure prediction to all-atom resolution with improved accuracy. This state-of-the-art performance has established AlphaFold3 as a foundation model for diverse generation and design tasks. However, its iterative design substantially increases inference time, limiting practical deployment in downstream settings such as virtual screening and protein design. We propose DCFold, a single-step generative model that attains AlphaFold3-level accuracy. Our Dual Consistency training framework, which incorporates a novel Temporal Geodesic Matching (TGM) scheduler, enables DCFold to achieve a 15x acceleration in inference while maintaining predictive fidelity. We validate its effectiveness across both structure prediction and binder design benchmarks.

### [628] [Domain Transfer Becomes Identifiable via a Single Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17918)
*Sagar Shrestha,Subash Timilsina,Hoang-Son Nguyen,Xiao Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Domain transfer (DT) maps source to target distributions and supports tasks such as unsupervised image-to-image translation, single-cell analysis, and cross-platform medical imaging. However, DT is fundamentally ill-posed: push-forward mappings are generally non-identifiable, as measure-preserving automorphisms (MPAs) preserve marginals while altering cross-domain correspondences, leading to content-misaligned translation. Recent work shows that MPAs can be eliminated by jointly transferring multiple corresponding source/target conditional distributions, but supervision signals labeling such conditionals are not always available in practice. We develop an alternative route to DT identifiability. Under a structural sparsity condition on the Jacobian support pattern, we show that distribution matching together with a single paired anchor sample suffices to identify the ground-truth transfer -- requiring substantially less supervision than prior approaches. To enable practical high-dimensional learning, we further propose an efficient Jacobian sparsity regularizer based on randomized masked finite differences, yielding a scalable surrogate without explicit Jacobian evaluation. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world DT tasks validate the theory.

### [629] [InfoFlow: A Framework for Multi-Layer Transformer Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17930)
*Penghao Yu,Haotian Jiang,Zeyu Bao,Qianxiao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: While the approximation properties of single-layer Transformer architectures have been studied in recent works, a rigorous theoretical understanding of the multi-layer setting remains limited. In this work, we establish that multi-layer Transformers possess fundamentally different approximation capabilities from single-layer ones: for certain retrieval tasks, any single-layer Transformer requires least $Ω(\varepsilon^{-k})$ parameters to achieve precision $\varepsilon$, where $k$ grows linearly with sequence length $T$, whereas a two-layer Transformer with a single head per layer achieves the same approximation precision with at most $O (\varepsilon^{-1})$ parameters. To understand this separation, we identify two structural mechanisms underlying multi-layer approximation. Specifically, softmax attention can only efficiently retrieve the token attaining the maximum attention score, incurring exponential-in-length parameter cost for $k$-th largest retrieval with $k \geq 2$. Moreover, the parameter cost of decoding coupled information scales with the size of the retrieved token set. Motivated by these findings, we propose InfoFlow, a framework for multi-layer Transformers. The framework tracks an information set of accessible input positions at each token and layer, assigning an explicit approximation rate to each mode of information propagation. This abstraction recovers known approximation bounds, remains consistent with experimental observations on trained networks, and yields concrete predictions in settings where direct theoretical analysis is currently intractable. Our results provide a principled framework for reasoning about the approximation efficiency of multi-layer Transformers.

### [630] [Training data attribution in diffusion models via mirrored unlearning and noise-consistent skew](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17938)
*Joan Serrà,Dipam Goswami,Fabio Morreale,Wei-Hsiang Liao,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Training data attribution (TDA) should enable generative model interpretability and foster a variety of related downstream tasks. Nonetheless, current TDA approaches lack reliability and robustness, preventing their adoption in real-world setups. In this paper, we take a decisive step towards more reliable and robust TDA for diffusion models. We propose to perform TDA with mirrored unlearning and noise-consistent skew (MUCS). The idea is to fine-tune a second model with bounded mirrored gradient ascent, and to measure the normalized skew of this model with respect to the original one using consistent noise samples. We show that, while being conceptually simple and generic, MUCS systematically outperforms existing methods on three different datasets by a large margin. We additionally study the effect that core design choices have on final performance, and analyze novel aspects regarding the overlap of influential instances across generated items and the potential of ensembling TDA approaches. We believe that our findings may have broader implications for more general unlearning setups, as well as for tasks requiring the comparison of diffusion losses.

### [631] [Enhancing the Code Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Consistency-based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17958)
*Zhanyue Qin,Jia Feng,Yibo Lyu,Yun Peng,Dianbo Sui,Cuiyun Gao,Qing Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Code reasoning refers to the task of predicting the output of a program given its source code and specific inputs. It can measure the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) and also benefit downstream tasks such as code generation and mathematical reasoning. Existing work has verified the effectiveness of reinforcement learning on the task. However, these methods design rewards solely based on final outputs or coarse-grained signals, and neglect the inherent consistency of the stepwise reasoning process in the task. Therefore, these methods often result in sparse reward or reward hacking, which limits the full play of enhanced learning capabilities. To alleviate these issues, we propose CodeThinker, a consistency-driven reinforcement learning framework for code reasoning. Specifically, CodeThinker has three key components: (1) a stepwise reasoning-aware model training module, which utilizes a consistency tracing paradigm as a template to synthesize training data that captures the stepwise reasoning process; (2) a dynamic beam sampling strategy, which aims to improve the quality of sampled outputs under a fixed sampling budget; and (3) a consistency reward mechanism that can effectively alleviate reward hacking. Experiments on three popular benchmarks show that CodeThinker achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple LLMs. For instance, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.3% in accuracy when deployed on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct. We also validate the effectiveness of CodeThinker on downstream tasks. Results show that, without additional training, CodeThinker obtains average accuracy gains of 5.33 and 3.11 percentage points on mathematical reasoning and code reasoning tasks covering 17 programming languages, respectively.

Specifically, CodeThinker has three key components: (1) a stepwise reasoning-aware model training module, which utilizes a consistency tracing paradigm as a template to synthesize training data that captures the stepwise reasoning process; (2) a dynamic beam sampling strategy, which aims to improve the quality of sampled outputs under a fixed sampling budget; and (3) a consistency reward mechanism that can effectively alleviate reward hacking. Experiments on three popular benchmarks show that CodeThinker achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple LLMs. For instance, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.3% in accuracy when deployed on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct. We also validate the effectiveness of CodeThinker on downstream tasks. Results show that, without additional training, CodeThinker obtains average accuracy gains of 5.33 and 3.11 percentage points on mathematical reasoning and code reasoning tasks covering 17 programming languages, respectively.

</details>


### [632] [Function graph transformers universally approximate operators between function spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17968)
*Takashi Furuya,David Mis,Ivan Dokmanić,Maarten V. de Hoop,Matti Lassas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study the approximation of nonlinear operators between function spaces by transformers. Our approach is to lift functions to measures supported on their graphs and leverage a recently introduced measure-theoretic view of transformers. A function $h$ is represented by its graph measure $γ_h$, with finite tokens $\{(x_j,h(x_j))\}_{j=1}^N$ being its empirical approximations. We show that this framework elegantly models discretization refinement via convergence of measures and provides a natural setting for operator learning. Within this framework, we introduce function graph transformers, a graph-preserving subclass of measure-theoretic transformers that maps graph measures to graph measures, which is to say that outputs remain single-valued functions. Crucially, this additional structure does not reduce generality: we prove that the resulting graph-preserving maps can be approximated by finite compositions of standard softmax self-attention layers and pointwise MLPs, yielding universal approximation results for broad classes of nonlinear operators. Unlike existing theoretical approaches to operator learning with transformers, the measure-theoretic framework also accommodates regularized negative-order Sobolev inputs for which discretization invariance is particularly challenging, as well as query points on different output domains. Overall, function graph transformers provide a continuum viewpoint and mathematical toolkit for transformer-based operator learning, clarifying the roles of positional encodings, graph structure, regularization, and ensuring consistency across discretizations.

### [633] [SAFE-SVD: Sensitivity-Aware Fidelity-Enforcing SVD for Physics Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17985)
*Chengjie Hong,Feixiang He,Yiheng Zeng,Lulu Kang,He Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We propose a new method for compressing physics foundation models (PFMs) which is a new trend in AI for Science. While model compression is essential for reducing memory use and accelerating inference in large foundation models, it remains under-explored for PFMs, where preserving physical fidelity is crucial. The challenge lies in the functional nature of physics data, where partial derivatives encode spatiotemporal dynamics and exhibit high sensitivity to compression. Conventional compression methods ignore this structure, often causing severe performance degradation or failure. To address this, we introduce a sensitivity-aware fidelity-enforcing compression framework that explicitly models loss-aware layer sensitivity in the output function space during compression. This provides a new route to compressing scientific foundation models while preserving accuracy and physical fidelity. Experiments show substantial gains over existing methods across multiple models and datasets, achieving significantly higher compression ratios while maintaining accuracy, in some cases by orders of magnitude. More broadly, the work potentially leads to a new subfield of efficient, deployable, and sustainable scientific foundation models in AI for Science.

### [634] [MARR: Module-Adaptive Residual Reconstruction for Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17997)
*Le Su,Xing Luo,Zhi Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Recently, residual reconstruction-based model quantization methods have achieved promising performance in low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) by introducing cross-layer residuals to reduce error accumulated from previous layers.However, these residuals may also introduce additional bias arising from the Hessian-approximation (HA) assumption underlying reconstruction-based PTQ, leading to suboptimal quantization performance.In this work, we analyze that multiplying the residual term by a scaling coefficient provides a direct way to mitigate the HA bias associated with residual strength, while preserving accumulated-error correction. More importantly, we observe that this trade-off is module-dependent, making a single global residual strength insufficient to balance effective correction and residual-related bias across modules.Based on these observations, we propose Module-Adaptive Residual Reconstruction (MARR), which assigns a module-specific scaling coefficient to adaptively balance accumulated-error correction and residual-related HA bias for each module.To avoid expensive per-module coefficient search and obtain a stable coefficient estimate, we design a Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID)-based adaptive update strategy that uses reconstruction error as feedback to progressively refine this coefficient. Experiments on several typical large language models (LLMs) and vision transformers (ViTs) demonstrate the effectiveness of MARR under low-bit quantization (less than or equal to 4-bit), achieving up to 20.2% performance gains on LLMs and up to 4.6% relative gains on ViTs over the residual reconstruction state-of-the-art methods.Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

### [635] [RL4RLA: Teaching ML to Discover Randomized Linear Algebra Algorithms Through Curriculum Design and Graph-Based Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18004)
*Jinglong Xiong,Xiaotian Liu,Ruoxin Wang,Zihang Liu,Yefan Zhou,Yujun Yan,Yaoqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Randomized linear algebra (RLA) algorithms are a modern class of numerical linear algebra techniques that play an essential role in scientific computing and machine learning, with broad and growing adoption. However, their discovery remains mostly a manual process that requires deep expert knowledge and inspiration. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a pathway to automation, standard approaches struggle with sparse reward landscapes and vast search spaces inherent to high-performing RLA algorithms. In this paper, we present RL4RLA, a general RL framework that automates the discovery of interpretable, symbolic RLA algorithms. Unlike black-box approaches, our method builds explicit algorithms from basic linear algebra primitives, ensuring verifiable and implementable representations. To enable efficient discovery, we introduce: (1) a numerical curriculum that progressively increments problem difficulty to encode inductive bias specific to the RLA domain; (2) Monte Carlo Graph Search, which optimizes exploration by identifying and merging equivalent partial algorithms. We demonstrate that RL4RLA rediscovers state-of-the-art methods, including sketch-and-precondition solvers, Randomized Kaczmarz, and Newton Sketch, and can be targeted to produce algorithms optimized for specific trade-offs between accuracy, speed, and stability. Code is available at https://github.com/Tim-Xiong/RL4RLA.

### [636] [Scalable Decision-Focused Learning through Cost-Sensitive Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18005)
*Noah Schutte,Senne Berden,Tias Guns,Krzysztof Postek,Neil Yorke-Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Many real-world combinatorial problems involve uncertain parameters, which can be predicted given contextual features and historical data. These `predict-then-optimize' or `contextual optimization' problems have gained significant attention: end-to-end training methods can now minimize the downstream task cost rather than the predictive error. However, despite their effectiveness, these decision-focused learning (DFL) approaches often rely on repeated solving of the underlying combinatorial optimization problem during training, making them computationally expensive and difficult to scale. We reframe the learning problem as a cost-sensitive multi-output regression problem: multi-output due to the combinatorial problem having multiple uncertain parameters, and cost-sensitive due to the downstream task cost being the real target. Our technical contribution is the formalization of multiple loss function components that follow from this reframing: cost-insensitive normalization, decision-aware asymmetric penalization of over- and underpredictions, and instance-based costs that mimic the true downstream task-based loss locally. These components require zero or one solve per training data instance, while requiring no further solves during training. Experiments show that the combination of loss components achieves comparable downstream task quality to the state of the art, while being significantly more efficient, enabling scaling to problem sizes that have not been tackled before with DFL.

### [637] [Uncertainty Reliability Under Domain Shift: An Investigation for Data-Driven Blood Pressure Estimation in Photoplethysmography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18008)
*Mohammad Moulaeifard,Ciaran Bench,Philip J. Aston,Nils Strodthoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is critical for safety-critical domains like healthcare, yet it is rarely evaluated under realistic out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions. Here, we assessed predictive performance and uncertainty reliability for deep learning-based blood pressure (BP) estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) signals under both in-distribution (ID) and OOD settings. Using an XResNet1D-50 trained on PulseDB and tested on four external datasets, we compared deep ensembles (DE) and Monte Carlo dropout (MCD) with Gaussian negative log-likelihood (GNLL) and mean squared error (MSE) losses, optionally followed by post-hoc recalibration via conformal prediction (CP), temperature scaling (TS), and isotonic regression (IR).
  The key findings of our study are as follows: (1) DE provides stronger predictive robustness under domain shift than MCD, an advantage that becomes clear primarily under external shift. (2) Recalibrated GNLL-based methods yield the best uncertainty calibration (e.g., GNLL+DE+CP for systolic blood pressure (SBP), GNLL+DE+TS for diastolic blood pressure (DBP)), while MSE-based uncertainty requires recalibration to become practically useful. (3) Across settings, CP and TS offer the most consistent gains, with IR remaining competitive in several cases.
  Overall, our results identify DE-based methods as most robust for predictive performance under domain shift, GNLL as strongest for native UQ, and recalibration as essential for making MSE-based uncertainty practical. These findings highlight the need to jointly assess predictive accuracy and calibration on external data for trustworthy cuffless BP estimation

### [638] [Federated Learning by Utility-Constrained Stochastic Aggregation for Improving Rational Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18020)
*M Yashwanth,Arunabh Singh,Ashok Nayak,Sai Kiran Bulusu,Anirban Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Federated Learning (FL) algorithms implicitly assume that clients passively comply with server-side orchestration by sharing local model updates upon server request. However, this overlooks an important aspect in real-world cross-silo environments: clients are often rational agents who may prioritize their utilities such as local model performance over that of the global model. In settings with significant statistical heterogeneity, rational clients may opt out of the federation if the perceived benefits of collaboration fail to meet their local utility thresholds. Such attrition degrades the global model performance and can lead to the collapse of the federated training process. In this work, we introduce FedUCA, (Federated Learning by Utility-Constrained Stochastic Aggregation for Improving Rational Participation), a framework that formalizes the server's role as an optimizer seeking to maximize global model performance by sustaining client participation. We substantiate our framework through extensive experiments on standard datasets demonstrating that by prioritizing participation feasibility, FedUCA achieves significantly higher client retention and, consequently, a superior global model performance.

### [639] [Unveiling Memorization-Generalization Coexistence: A Case Study on Arithmetic Tasks with Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18022)
*Linyu Liu,Pinyan Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Highly over-parameterized models can simultaneously memorize noisy labels and generalize well, yet how these behaviors coexist remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the underlying mechanisms of this coexistence using modular arithmetic tasks under heavy label noise. Through extensive experiments on two-layer neural networks, we find that larger models tend to generalize better under appropriate optimization and model configurations, while noisy labels are memorized faster than clean data. Over-parameterized models internally form a generalization structure, but its expression in the output is suppressed by the need to fit noisy labels. Remarkably, even with 80\% label noise, near-perfect test accuracy can be achieved by extracting this internal structure using frequency-based methods. We further propose a task-agnostic method to partition networks into generalization and memorization components. Although this subnetwork improves generalization, it is limited compared with frequency-based extraction, indicating that the generalization structure is distributed across neurons and motivating the development of new tools to retrieve generalizable knowledge from over-parameterized networks.

### [640] [FedSDR: Federated Self-Distillation with Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18028)
*Ziheng Ren,Zhanming Shen,Hao Wang,Ning Liu,You Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Federated fine-tuning of Large Language Models faces severe statistical heterogeneity. However, existing model-level defenses often overlook the root cause: intrinsic data distribution mismatches. In this work, we first establish Federated Self-Distillation (FedSD) as a fundamental and potent strategy. By projecting client representations into a smoothed ``model-understanding space,'' FedSD alone serves as a universal booster, demonstrating superior performance over conventional algorithms. Despite its success, we identify a subtle trade-off termed the Rewrite Paradox -- unconstrained self-distillation can inadvertently increase hallucinations and redundancy. To refine this paradigm, we further propose FedSDR (Federated Self-Distillation with Rectification), the ultimate reinforced framework. It augments FedSD with a dual-stream mechanism: a local LoRA-S (Smoothing) branch to implicitly absorb heterogeneity via distilled data, and a parallel global LoRA-R (Rectification) branch anchored to raw data to enforce factual correctness. By selectively aggregating only LoRA-R, FedSDR yields a globally aligned and faithful model. Extensive experiments verify its superior performance.
